counts.note: effectFrames/hitFrames count every entry including shared-frame duplicates; Unique counts deduplicate by file content hash.

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them. Placeholder frames are byte-identical across skills and counted once in Unique totals.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 32 frames) between: showdown-4121017, showdown-4121021.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 10 frames) between: flash-jump-4001011, flash-jump-4001014.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 9 frames) between: hexa-quad-star-4141000, quad-star-4121013.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 9 frames) between: hexa-death-star-4141010, hexa-death-star-4141013.
Frames shared (byte-identical, 8 frames) between: throw-blasting-400041062, throw-blasting-400041079.
HEXA boost cores (Skill/40000.img 400004xxx) are passive: no effect/hit frames of their own; their visuals are the boosted skill's frames.
V-skill Boost core IDs were not located in the 400004xxx scan; passive cores with no frames, so no visuals are missing.

Venom Burst (400041000) is a thief-common 5th-job skill shared by Night Lord, Shadower, Dual Blade and Night Walker; the duplicate node 400040000 (identical name/description, no frames) is not included. Triple Throw (400041017) and Quad Star (400041018) appear as reference nodes in Skill/40004.img with the same frame counts as their job-skillbook versions and are not duplicated here.
Last Resort (400041032) is a common 5th-job skill, not class-specific; included once here for completeness.

skills.name: Double Stab
skills.description: Quickly stab a nearby enemy twice. Can only be used when equipped with a dagger.

skills.name: Lucky Seven
skills.description: Throw 7 lucky throwing stars to attack enemies in front. Can only be used when equipped with a claw.

skills.name: Haste
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Dark Sight
skills.description: Allows you to hide in the shadows for a short time to avoid the enemy's attack. While Dark Sight is active, you can deactivate it either by using another skill or by pressing the Dark Sight skill key again. Note that certain movement skills will not cancel Dark Sight. Upon deactivating Dark Sight, its cooldown will vary according to damage dodged in proportion to your to Max HP.

skills.name: Flash Jump
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher this skill's level, the farther you will jump. Can be activated with the Jump key.

skills.name: Nimble Body
skills.description: Permanently increases Luck.

skills.name: Magic Theft
skills.description: Chance to steal a target's buff for yourself.

skills.name: Flash Jump
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump twice in a row. The jump distance increases as the skill level increases. Can also be used with the Jump Key.

skills.name: Side Step
skills.description: Permanently increases Avoidability.

skills.name: Bandit Slash
skills.description: Lash out at a group of enemies with crossing blades.

skills.name: Shuriken Burst
skills.description: Throw three exploding shurikens that ricochet to nearby enemies on hit. Shurikens detonate when they hit their first enemy.

skills.name: Shuriken Burst
skills.description: Throw three exploding shurikens that ricochet to nearby enemies on hit. Shurikens detonate when they hit their first enemy.

skills.name: Gust Charm
skills.description: Throws a talisman containing fierce shadow power to damage and knock back enemies. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Assassin's Mark
skills.description: Has a chance to tag the enemy with the assassin's mark when attacking. The next attack on a marked enemy will cause throwing stars to form on that enemy and attack other enemies nearby. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest Max HP first and are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Assassin's Mark
skills.description: While attacking with this skill, you have a chance to leave an assassin's mark on your target. The next attack on a marked enemy will cause throwing stars to form on that enemy and attack other enemies nearby. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first and are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Shadow Surge
skills.description: Meld into shadow and surge quickly forward. Attacking marked enemies fills you with shadowy power, reducing the delay until you can use the skill again.\nYou can move while using attack skills.

skills.name: Shadow Leap
skills.description: Harness the power of shadow to leap into the air.

skills.name: Shadow Blink
skills.description: Harness your shadow to move forward swiftly.

skills.name: Claw Mastery
skills.description: Increases Claw Mastery and the max number of charges.

skills.name: Agile Claws
skills.description: Increases Claw Attack Speed and Luck.

skills.name: Critical Throw
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases LUK and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Triple Throw
skills.description: Throw 3 throwing stars simultaneously. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Shuriken Challenge
skills.description: Summon a large shadow-powered shuriken to annihilate enemies.

skills.name: Dark Flare
skills.description: Release dark energy, for a certain period of time, to summon a large shuriken that attacks enemies nearby. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Shadow Partner
skills.description: Summons a shadow partner that mimics the summoner. It does not have its own HP, and disappears when it is hit with an attack that changes its appearance or restricts movement. It cannot mimic summoning skills, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Spirit of the Star
skills.description: Allows you to attack without consuming Throwing Stars, and increases Attack Power and Boss Damage.\nThe first Throwing Star in your inventory will be used to calculate your damage. Throwing Star skills cannot be used if there are no Throwing Stars in your inventory.

skills.name: Enveloping Darkness
skills.description: Cloaks yourself in darkness, increasing Max HP, Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Venom
skills.description: Poison is permanently applied to your Claw, giving all your attacks the chance to Poison enemies. The Poison is not stackable, and it cannot cause enemies' HP to drop below 1.

skills.name: Expert Throwing Star Handling
skills.description: The Thief's secret technique increases Final Damage and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Alchemic Adrenaline
skills.description: Increases the effect of recovery items like potions. Does not work on percentage-based recovery items like elixirs. Also increases Critical Damage permanently and allows you to resist knock-back effects when struck.

skills.name: Quad Star
skills.description: Masterfully unleash four throwing stars. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Showdown
skills.description: Attacks up to 6 enemies and provokes them, making them untouchable.\nProvoked enemies grant more EXP and items. Bosses suffer half of the effect.\nWhen the talisman explodes, it creates a dark shuriken, which then pursues and attacks nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Showdown
skills.description: Toss a throwing star imbued with the power of shadows.

skills.name: Night Lord's Mark
skills.description: Further enhances the assassin's mark, increasing the probability of leaving a mark, the damage, and the number of throwing stars. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first and are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Night Lord's Mark
skills.description: Further enhances the assassin's mark, increasing the probability of leaving a mark, the damage, and the number of throwing stars. Throwing stars target the enemy with the highest HP first and are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sudden Raid
skills.description: Call in a horde of friends to attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Frailty Curse
skills.description: Summons a barrier around you. Decreases the Attack Power, Speed, and Defense of enemies that step into the barrier. Also allows you to deal more damage to bosses.

skills.name: Nightfall Signet
skills.description: Hide your presence beneath a veil of darkness and become temporarily invincible. The skill can be canceled by using it again.\nNot affected by Skill reset.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Dark Harmony
skills.description: Become one with the darkness  to deal more damage.

skills.name: Shadow Shifter
skills.description: Grants a chance to summon a wooden doll to take damage in your place. Also permanently increases your resistance to knockback effects when struck.

skills.name: Toxic Venom
skills.description: Increases Venom's poison chance and permanently increases poison damage.

skills.name: Claw Expert
skills.description: Increases Claw Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Showdown - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Showdown. Doesn't apply to the shadow shuriken created with Showdown.

skills.name: Showdown - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Showdown. Doesn't apply to the shadow shuriken created with Showdown.

skills.name: Showdown - Enhance
skills.description: Increases EXP and items from enemies provoked by Showdown.

skills.name: Frailty Curse - Enhance
skills.description: Increases the Attack Power and Defense penalty from Frailty Curse.

skills.name: Frailty Curse - Slow
skills.description: Increases the Speed penalty from Frailty Curse.

skills.name: Frailty Curse - Boss Rush
skills.description: Bosses are affected by Frailty Curse.

skills.name: Quad Star - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Quad Star damage.

skills.name: Quad Star - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monsters with Quad Star.

skills.name: Quad Star - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Number of Attacks for Quad Star.

skills.name: Death Star
skills.description: Summons 4 shurikens that combine into one giant shuriken.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Bleed Dart
skills.description: Coats your stars with a deadly poison that causes bleeding, increasing Attack Power and inflicting continuous damage on enemies.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Venom Burst
skills.description: Poison your weapon to deal damage over time to enemies.
skills.note: Thief-common 5th-job skill (Night Lord, Shadower, Dual Blade, Night Walker); passive in GMS 270.

skills.name: Throwing Star Barrage
skills.description: Temporarily grants your throwing skills extra spread. Does not apply to Shadow Partner.

skills.name: Shurrikane
skills.description: Throws a massive shuriken said to be used by the thieves of old. Unaffected by attack reflection. Reduced chance of activating Assassin's Mark.

skills.name: Dark Lord's Omen
skills.description: Unleash the power of the Dark Lord's insight. You can detonate the scroll immediately by using the skill again. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Throw Blasting
skills.description: Throw shurikens with explosive charms attached. The charms explode after the shurikens hit, dealing additional attack to nearby enemies. Explosions are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Throw Blasting
skills.description: Explosive charm is getting ready.

skills.name: Last Resort
skills.description: You vow to destroy your enemies at any cost. You can renew your vow to empower its effects by using the skill again while it's active. Using the skill with the down arrow key will immediately renew your vow. With Action Customization enabled, you can renew your vow by pressing its key again, without use of the arrow keys.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF
